title: Moth Trap Photo Processing Backlog
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mothtrap:session
| search processing_status="complete"
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by trap_id
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which trapss have gone quiet for moth-trap photo processing.
value: A long gap since the last processed session means the classification backlog is outrunning the field work.
implementation: Send moth-trap photo processing events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of trapss with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals which trapss have gone quiet longer than they should for moth-trap photo processing.
